properties.title: General Warning
properties.body:
EASTERN MEDITERRANEAN SEA.
STRAIT OF SICILY.
TUNISIA-NORTHEAST COAST.
DNC 08.
1. UNDERWATER OPERATIONS 15 NOV THRU 15 DEC
   BY M/V REDEEMER IN AREA BETWEEN
   37-01.06N 37-01.05N AND 011-03.67E 011-03.68E.
   1000 METER BERTH REQUESTED.
2. CANCEL THIS MSG 16 DEC 16.
